arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ.
transliteration: Subhaanal-lathee yusabbihur-ra'du bihamdihi walmalaa'ikatu min kheefatih.
translation: Glory is to Him Whom thunder and angels extol from fear of Him.
reference: Al-Muwatta' 2/992. It was graded authentic as a statement of Abdullah bin Az-Zubair by Al-Albani
